overview_description.description: Baksheesh is a fintech platform focused on digital tipping, rewards, and cashless payment solutions for service-oriented businesses and frontline workers. The platform enables customers to send tips and incentives electronically through QR codes and digital payment methods, reducing reliance on cash transactions. It is designed for industries such as hospitality, delivery, retail, and personal services, where gratuity and employee rewards are commonly used. Baksheesh.io also provides businesses with tools for managing tip distribution, tracking transactions, and improving payment transparency.

product.description: A platform offering digital menu, ordering, and checkout solutions for restaurants, allowing customers to view menus, place orders, and pay via mobile devices or in-house tablets.

product.name: Baksheesh Pay
product.description: A modern point-of-sale system using QR codes for transactions, allowing businesses to accept payments via mobile terminals or static signboards.
